# moodle-cli 0.5.4

## Summary

This patch pins the GitHub Actions publisher to an npm version with trusted publishing support.

## Fixes

- Install `npm@11.17.0` in the release job before publishing through GitHub OIDC.
- Keep the package-content guard that verifies `dist/moodle.js` is present before publish.

## Validation

Validated with:

- `npm run check`
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run pack:check`
